item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in desperate video plea to potential kidnappers of her mother
item.description: By CHRISTOPHER WEBER and TY ONEIL TUCSON, Ariz. item.title: 1,500 Baltimore County residents left without power due to windy conditions
item.description: Residents were left without power on Saturday due to windy gusts reaching up to 55 mph, according to BGE.

item.title: Navy men’s basketball beats American, 82-73, remains on top of Patriot League
item.description: Led by double-doubles from Aiden Kehoe and Donovan Draper, Navy beat American on Saturday to avenge its only Patriot League loss.

item.title: Terrance Gore, speedy outfielder who played for 3 World Series champions, dies at 34
item.description: Terrance Gore, a speedy outfielder who played for three World Series champions while spending parts of eight seasons in the major leagues, has died. He was 34.

item.title: Orioles beat Keegan Akin in arbitration in first win this year for clubs
item.description: The Orioles won their salary arbitration case Saturday against pitcher Keegan Akin, the first victory for teams this year.

item.title: Former Jan. 6 Capitol officer Harry Dunn eyes House seat
item.description: The race is expected to be a crowded Democratic primary in the deep-blue district.

item.title: Navy sinks Army in men’s NCAA gymnastics | PHOTOS
item.description: The Navy Midshipmen defeat the visiting Army Black Knights, with a score of 308.2 to 303.0, in men’s NCAA gymnastics Saturday at Halsey Field House in Annapolis.

item.title: Four Penn North rowhouses burn in two-alarm fire
item.description: Baltimore City firefighters extinguished a two-alarm fire that affected four Penn North homes Saturday.

item.title: Spalding’s Taina Fernandez makes history as 1st girl to win MIAA wrestling title
item.description: Spalding junior Taina Fernandez became the first girl to win an MIAA wrestling title after scoring a late takedown in Saturday's tournament.

item.title: Falcons’ James Pearce Jr. arrested after what police said was a domestic dispute with WNBA player
item.description: Falcons rookie star James Pearce Jr. was arrested near Miami on Saturday night after fleeing officers and then crashing his car following what police said was a domestic dispute with WNBA player Rickea Jackson.
